S: Baked potato skins filled with cheddar and bacon, sour cream on top

Small potatoes baked, halved and scooped, brushed with butter and crisped at 220C, filled with cheddar and bacon, baked again, sour cream and chives. Bake 8 small potatoes at 200C for 45 minutes. Halve, scoop and brush with 40g butter. Crisp at 220C for 10 minutes, fill with 150g cheddar and 150g cooked bacon and bake 5 more minutes. Top with sour cream and chives.
Crisp lavash rectangles around a whipped feta and yoghurt dip
Lavash cut into neat rectangles like sheets of paper, brushed with oil and salt, baked at 180C until crisp, stacked with a whipped feta dip in the middle.
blistered capsicum with garlic and sherry vinegar over ricotta on sourdough, a case of the Mondays

Red capsicums blistered and peeled, dressed with garlic, olive oil, sherry vinegar and basil, piled onto toasted sourdough over whipped ricotta. Roast 4 red capsicums whole at 220C for 30 minutes, turning once, until blackened. Cover in a bowl for 10 minutes, then peel, seed and cut into strips. Dress with 3 tbsp olive oil, a crushed garlic clove, 1 tbsp sherry vinegar, salt and torn basil. Beat 250g ricotta with lemon zest and salt. Toast 8 slices sourdough, spread with ricotta and pile on the capsicum.
M: Crisp skinned snapper with lemon and capers, twice fried chips, green salad
Snapper fillets dusted in seasoned flour, pan-fried skin down in butter until crisp, with lemon, capers and parsley. Chips and a green salad.
paprika and sugar rubbed pork, baked low and glazed sticky, coleslaw, served by Joanna

Pork ribs rubbed with paprika, brown sugar and garlic, baked low and slow in foil, then glazed sticky under the grill, with creamy coleslaw. Mix 2 tbsp smoked paprika, 3 tbsp brown sugar, 2 tsp garlic powder and 2 tsp salt and rub over 2kg pork ribs. Wrap tightly in foil and bake at 150C for 2.5 hours. Unwrap, brush with 250ml barbecue sauce and grill on high for 5 minutes until sticky and charred. Toss half a shredded cabbage and 2 grated carrots with 125g mayo and 1 tbsp cider vinegar for coleslaw.
W: Vanilla slab cake with buttercream and sprinkles
Vanilla sheet cake baked at 175C for 30 minutes, covered in fluffy buttercream, cut into enough squares for everyone, Milton first.
K: Strong chilled coffee with homemade vanilla syrup over ice

Strong coffee cooled over ice with milk and vanilla syrup, topped with a scoop of vanilla ice cream and a dusting of cocoa. Brew 500ml strong coffee and chill. Simmer 60g caster sugar with 60ml water and a split vanilla bean for 3 minutes and cool. Fill four tall glasses with ice, add 30ml vanilla syrup to each, then pour in 125ml coffee and 100ml cold milk. Top each with a small scoop of vanilla ice cream and dust with cocoa.
